content.class.ringer.blurb: 一盏照路的提灯，一角守夜时垫肚子的面包。
content.class.ringer.kit.0.name: 守夜提灯
content.class.ringer.name: 敲钟人
content.fx.ring-the-passing-bell.oc.go-out-among: 这不是你们进来时墓园里响着的那支曲子。一段接一段，没有间歇。
content.fx.ring-the-passing-bell.oc.ring-the-bel: 钟声穿过门口，掠过墓碑。墓园里，有什么接住了它。
content.obj.ring-the-passing-bell.come-back-insi: 沿原路返回，从小教堂门口进去。
content.obj.ring-the-passing-bell.enter-the-chap: 沿石板路穿过墓碑，从小教堂门口进去。
content.obj.ring-the-passing-bell.go-out-among-t: 从小教堂门口出去，穿过墓园，走到远处角落的老紫杉旁。
在中殿尽头，祭坛台阶上的钟架上。
content.quest.ring-the-passing-bell.goal: 穿过墓园，进入小教堂，在祭坛前敲响丧钟，再回到墓碑之间听听有什么回应，然后回到小教堂里。
content.world.outro: 钟已不再摇荡。墓园里，它带起的调子还在继续。
content.world.title: 钟声改变曲调

source.class.ringer.blurb: A lantern for the path and a heel of bread for the vigil.
source.class.ringer.kit.0.name: Vigil Lantern
source.class.ringer.name: Ringer
source.fx.ring-the-passing-bell.oc.go-out-among: It is not the tune the yard was playing when you came in. It does not stop between verses.
source.fx.ring-the-passing-bell.oc.ring-the-bel: The bell's note goes out through the door and over the stones. Out in the yard, something takes it up.
source.obj.ring-the-passing-bell.come-back-insi: Back up the path and in at the chapel door.
source.obj.ring-the-passing-bell.enter-the-chap: Up the flagstone path through the stones, in at the chapel door.
source.obj.ring-the-passing-bell.go-out-among-t: Back out of the door and across to the old yew in the far corner of the yard.
At the far end of the nave, on its frame on the altar step.
source.quest.ring-the-passing-bell.goal: Walk up through the churchyard into the chapel, ring the passing bell at the altar, go back out among the stones to hear what answers, and come back inside.
source.world.outro: The bell has stopped swinging. Out in the yard, the tune it started is still going.
source.world.title: The Bell Changes the Tune
